verdict.rationale: TypeSafe ships an official agent skill, installed via `claude plugin marketplace add typesafe-ai/skills`, that it describes as a drop-in for Claude Code, Codex and other agent environments. It also documents coding-agent usage and maintains first-party Python and JS/TS SDKs with typed clients and retries. A third-party awesome list tags community projects per coding agent and has a large Infra/SDKs/Integrations category, and a community user reports using Jev via OpenRouter. Missing for 10: official integrations with named agent frameworks (e.g. adapters or tool wrappers), detailed integration docs beyond a skill-install line, and independent hands-on confirmation that the skill works in Claude Code or Codex.
